messages.subject: Re: web-based analysis using SEM.
parts:
On 03/02/2016 06:00 AM, Keon-Woong Moon wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> I have developed a shiny app perform web-based analysis using SEM.

One thing that was pointed out to me by others: the app itself does not
explicitly say it is using 'lavaan' (a hint is given in section 6.
Inspect). (I do see it is mentioned in the 'about' and 'citation' page).

I would suggest to make this clear somewhere at the top of the front
page. Some people may find it reassuring that the 'back-engine' of your
shiny app is lavaan.

Yves.
